limits: Aliases are only identical runtime function objects. Equal function-body SHA with distinct closure instances is not merged. Even shared functions may use different parameters, so shared implementation does not prove semantic equivalence or permit dropping selected intents.
Native registry engine provides static implementation identity only, not browser font or rendering evidence.
Plans and primary FAV alone do not provide executed branch population.
Important non-primary intents remain UNMEASURED until Native dispatch plus final encoded semantic correspondence exist.
